|errata_history=The Players Committee first published this Virtual card on an old-style slip (before its December 2006 remaster of the set). The sheet copy that survives is the February 2003 re-issue PDF; the date of the first release is unknown (the sheet gives the legal date 5 February 2003). Icons printed on the slip are written here in brackets ([Pilot], [Immune to Alter], [Immune to Sense], [Immune to Control]); ▲ and ▼ are printed as such. Versions of the Virtual Original card, in date order:
* '''Original''' (this page): the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown). Full text: “May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot aboard provides ability of 2. May move as a 'react'. When in battle with your piloted AT-AT, may target one opponent's character present and cancel target's game text for remainder of turn.”
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Blizzard Scout 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]]): the Players Committee remaster sheet (Virtual Set 4: Battle Of Hoth, official text as of 4 December 2006). Full text: “May add 1 pilot or passenger. Permanent pilot provides ability of 2. May move as a ‘react.’ During battle, if with your piloted AT-AT, may cancel game text of an opponent’s character present.” '''What changed:''' removed “aboard”; “'react'. When in battle” → “‘react.’ During battle, if”; removed “target one opponent's character present and”; removed “target's”; removed “for remainder”; “turn.” → “an opponent’s character present.”.
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf#page=4 VirtualCards4.pdf] — the Players Committee's Virtual Set #4 sheet (PDF made 4 February 2003, a February 2003 re-issue; legal date on the sheet 5 February 2003; first release date unknown); page 4, slip 28. Slip image and game text from this sheet. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008195348/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards4.pdf Internet Archive primary-source copy].
* Lore and art: the printed Decipher card, [[Blizzard Scout 1]].
* Later text: [[Blizzard Scout 1 (V) (Virtual Set 4) (Errata)]] (the 4 December 2006 remaster).
